title: "RabbunAllah, HasbunAllah"
body:
(dt.: AtomwaffenSindKinderspielzeuge)
As-salaamu `alaykum `ibaadAllah. (Mawlana Shaykh stands) As-salaat wa 's-salaaam `alaa Sayyidina
Muhammad wa `alaa aalihi wa sahbihi wa sallam wa `ala jamee`i 'l-anbiya wa 'l-mursaleen wa man
tabi`ahum bi-ihsaanin ila yawmi 'd-deen. (Mawlana Shaykh sits)
O People! Hamdanlillah. O our Attenders! We are giving our most high glorifying to our Lord, Almighty
Allah, and salutes and glorifying to His most beloved deputy, Sayyidi 'l-Awwaleen wa ’l-Akhireen, Sayyidina
Muhammad (s)! (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits) Everything must be under the title of Bismillahi 'rRahmani 'r-Raheem. We are saying, Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem, and a`oodhu billahi min ashShaytaani 'r-rajeem.
O People! Run away from Shaytan! It is the best day, Jumu`ah, here and Hereafter. If you are asking for
happiness here and Hereafter, keep respect for Jumu`ah.
O People! I am a weak one. Today I am coming here for Jumu`ah prayers, alhamdulillah. I am looking that
people are attending Jumu`ah and running to dhikr. I am only giving a short advice today as they are sending

to me. First of all, I am sitting here and two words have just been granted to me. SubhaanAllah, the whole
dunya is now under a heavy pressure or condition, among people and among each other. And from the
Heavens, there are atharu ghadab, signs of anger, from the Lord of Heavens.
O People! How can we be in safety? I am just sitting here and it is coming to my heart to say this very easily.
It is a hadeeth an-nabawiyyatu 'sh-shareefa, and all of the Children of Adam must listen because everyone is
under a very heavy condition or heavy pressure! Coming under their feet are volcanoes and hurricanes, and
don't think that hurricanes are only coming to America! Everything is going to be by heavenly order, "Go
there and take them away!" Now people are trembling. Why? There may be an earthquake, no one knows if
there may be a flood carrying everything away. There may be a hurricane and that is more difficult and more
terrible, coming and taking everything. Now people are also afraid anywhere there are volcanoes. If people
are under heavy fear from nuclear bombs, what is that? That is as a toy for children (compared to what Allah
Almighty can send on them)! (Mawlana Shaykh laughs) A hurricane may come on a nuclear reactor and take
them away. SubhaanAllah. Allah! Allahu Akbar! Allahu Akbar! HasbunAllah, RabbunAllah.

HasbunAllah, RabbunAllah. HasbunAllah, RabbunAllah. (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits) Laa
ilaaha illa-Llah. Subhaan Sen. Sultaan Sen.
Ayyuhal `ulamas! Arab `ulamas, Hind `ulamas, Yemen `ulamas,Sham `ulamas, Baghdad `ulamas, Egypt
`ulamas, Libya `ulamas! Hear, O `ulamas! I am not saying "Salafi `ulamas" now, finished! `Ulamas! I am
trying to be rabbani, but I am weak. I am trying to follow them.
O People! Try to follow rabbaaniyeen, those who belong to the Lord of Heavens! Mashaa-Allah, mashaaAllah. Grant us, yaa rijaalAllah! And I am speaking two words to all the people of the world. That is the
wasiya, advice of the Seal of Prophets (s)!

SubhaanAllah! How this has come to me? I am not thinking on it, because everyone is asking for protection
and the Seal of Prophets (s) is giving that to people. How can it be? Kaana Rasool salaat was salaam `alay,
kaana ar-rasool salawaatullah wa salaamahu `alayh, maa naqatu wa raghu ibn `amuhu Sayyidina `Abbas.
Hadeeth shareef, it is through our `ulamas, that Rasoolullah (s), (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits) was ready
and saying, "O my cousin! You are asking to be under Divine Protection here and Hereafter. Ahfizhillah
yahfazhak, ‘Keep Allah, Allah keeps you.’ Kullu 'l-`uloom hunaak, ‘Every knowledge is here.’ Keep Allah

Almighty's high respect! Be respectful to Allah and Allah will protect you here and Hereafter. Don't worry!
Finished!”
O `ulamas! Say this to your people throughout the east and west. O Christians! Say this to the chief ones, the
Holy Pope! I am asking him to translate what I am saying, if it is true or not. If it is true, they must say to
their nations, "O People! Keep the right way, safe way, clean way. You must leave this lifestyle that you are
living now, as it is the worst. If you are asking to be in safety here and Hereafter, keep high respect for your
Lord, Allah Almighty.” Allahu Akbar. (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits)
Ayyuhal patriarchs and also the holy one, chief rabbi! If I am saying anything wrong, say, "Shaykh is speaking
wrong." What is written in the Old Testament and New Testament? What is it teaching people? All holy books
are teaching, "O People! Always be respectful and obedient in the Divinely Presence. Obedient ones will be
saved, and for disobedient ones, there is only fear here and Hereafter."
This, I think, waaridun min as-samaa, divinely inspiration just reached to my heart. Can anyone say anything
about this? It can't be! It can't be! All religions are calling people and all prophets were calling people: "O
People! Be obedient servants for the Lord of Heavens and you will have a sweet life here and an Eternal Life
there. Keep respect for your Lord and try to be obedient servants, and beware of being disobedient! Every
trouble, azaab, every kind of punishment will come on those people who are disobedient!"
O Learned People! You must listen to this and you must try to make your people obedient servants! If you are
insisting to be disobedient, you will always be in a fearful life. When punishment is coming to you, you will be
in fear, and there will be no sweet life for them. But those who are obedient ones are sleeping, and never
thinking that an earthquake might come on them, or a flood, fire or hurricane, as it will never touch them.
O People! Keep this advice. You know I am trying to be obedient and you are trying to be obedient ones.
Don't leave disobedient ones to be your rulers; this is also very important. O Mankind! Don't leave
disobedient ones and unbelievers to be your rulers. If you are in fear of them, you must say,

RabbunAllah HasbunAllah. RabbunAllah HasbunAllah.
RabbunAllah HasbunAllah. RabbunAllah HasbunAllah.
RabbunAllah HasbunAllah. RabbunAllah HasbunAllah.

RabbunAllah HasbunAllah. RabbunAllah HasbunAllah.
If all the people living, for example, in a country, were to say, RabbunAllah HasbunAllah, their tyrants
must come down! If ahl 'ush-shaam (people of Damascus) are saying, RabbunAllah HasbunAllah,

RabbunAllah HasbunAllah, RabbunAllah HasbunAllah, RabbunAllah HasbunAllah,
RabbunAllah HasbunAllah, RabbunAllah HasbunAllah for forty days, that jabbaar, tyrant will come
down! If ahlu 'l-Iraq (people of Iraq) are saying, RabbunAllah HasbunAllah, RabbunAllah
HasbunAllah, RabbunAllah HasbunAllah; in forty days it shall be changed. If ahlu 'fars (people of
Persia) are saying RabbunAllah HasbunAllah, RabbunAllah HasbunAllah, RabbunAllah
HasbunAllah, Allah will change it in forty days, everywhere!
O People! We are giving you such a power that no one can expect! This power is over their nuclear powers!
Yaa Rabbee, shukr. If Turks are also asking to be in safety and to remove jabaabira, tyrants, the whole nation
must say:

RabbunAllah HasbunAllah. RabbunAllah HasbunAllah.
RabbunAllah HasbunAllah. RabbunAllah HasbunAllah.
RabbunAllah HasbunAllah. RabbunAllah HasbunAllah.
RabbunAllah HasbunAllah. RabbunAllah HasbunAllah.
Ay Rabbimiz! Anta `alam bi haalana, “O our Lord! You are fully aware of our state.”
Yaa musabbib al-haal wa 'l-ahwaal qawwiyy da`fana hatta nakoon mujtahideen fee ta`atika wa `ibadatik, “O
Sender of Causes! Strengthen our weakness until we become hard workers in Your obedience and Your
worship.”
Yaa Rabbi 'l-`izzat wa 'l-`azhamat bi jaahi nabbiyina, nabi ar-rahmah, Sayyidi 'l-Awwaleen wa ’l-Akhireen, bi
hurmati 'l-Fatihah.
